title: Assemble the Queue Digest
subtitle: The 5:00 PM health digest, by lookup
scenario: It is 5:00 PM. Assemble the queue-health digest - the day's volume, P1s, breaches, and misroutes - by LOOKING each number up from a stored artifact. If you find yourself recounting tickets, stop: the pipeline already tallied them.
input: Assembly rule: every number comes from a stored artifact. Total tickets triaged today: 3. P1 incidents (from classification/priority): 1. SLA breaches (from the SLA tracker): 0. Misroutes (from the misroute check): 0. Top category by volume: outage. Assemble the 5:00 PM digest.
instructions: Fill the volume slot from the day's ticket count (3).
Fill P1s, breaches, and misroutes from the tracker and checks.
Fill the top category from the day's classifications.
copilotPrompt: Fill the queue-digest slots by lookup: totalTickets 3, p1Count 1, breachCount 0, misrouteCount 0, topCategory outage. Do not recount - read from the stored artifacts.
successMessage: Digest assembled. Every number traces to a triage artifact - Support Ops can trust it.
editorHelper: Fill each slot by lookup - the pipeline already tallied.

sections.title: Assembly is lookup
sections.body: The digest is not new analysis - it is proven numbers gathered. Volume, P1s, breaches, and misroutes all live in artifacts the pipeline built. Recounting is a chance to introduce error.

sections.title: Traceable by construction
sections.body: Because every figure comes from a stored artifact, Support Ops can trust the digest and drill into any number. A hand-tuned figure is a report nobody can audit.

sections.title: Health, not just volume
sections.body: The digest is a health check: breaches and misroutes matter as much as counts. It is how the desk sees whether the day went well, not just how busy it was.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: queue-digest.md - the module's deliverable, sent to the Support DL and archived after.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd pull the day's counts from your tracker into a one-page summary rather than re-tallying tickets by hand.

tools.powerAutomate: compose the digest from the tracked counts
tools.zapier: a Formatter + digest step from prior totals
